scene_objective: In the setup phase, this sequel scene reveals the Ruusan Corridor's strategic network of installations containing a central fortress, transforming Ben's routine survey into a mission-defining discovery that deepens his personal investment and surfaces the tension between reporting up the chain and acting independently.

turning_point.trigger: The navigation data resolves into a route connecting multiple installations in a perimeter pattern around a central fortress.
turning_point.shift: This is not one facility; it is a network. The problem expands from survey-sized to strategic-infrastructure-sized.
turning_point.cost: Ben's investment deepens—this becomes his mission, not Luke's survey. Desh raises the professional question of reporting for backup, forcing Ben to confront acting on knowledge he cannot unknow.

closing_beat: Coordinates resolved on the nav computer. The destination lay deep in uncharted space—no hyperspace lane, no Republic survey, nothing. Something had been deliberately hidden there.

emotional_arc.start: Analytical focus—Ben executes a technical task with professional detachment.
emotional_arc.shift: Dawning scope—the data reveals a scale that tightens his attention and reframes the problem.
emotional_arc.end: The weight of decision—Ben braces against the knowledge that he cannot unknow this and waiting for backup may not be an option.

key_beats.beat_description: Desh pries open a corroded access panel and jams a modern data coupler into ancient storage media; the connection sparks twice before holding.
key_beats.state_change: The abstract opening pressure becomes concrete and tactile. Ancient systems resist modern equipment, making the technical challenge real.
key_beats.pov_reaction: Ben's analytical focus sharpens into action-readiness; his instinct drives him to solve amid the facility's cold and humming power cells, where the Force's recording pressure sits beneath without articulation.

key_beats.beat_description: Holographic star maps flicker to life, showing the Ruusan Corridor network—multiple installations in a perimeter pattern around a central fortress; Desh identifies it as military command-and-control architecture, spotting Gavran's name on a log.
key_beats.state_change: The operational picture expands from single site to perimeter network, revealing deliberate strategic containment.
key_beats.pov_reaction: Pressure shifts from ambient to directional as Ben registers the geometry and scale; chest tightens, senses sharpen on the fact without theorizing builders or purpose.

key_beats.beat_description: Ben copies fortress coordinates and route data to the Steady Returns' nav computer while Desh questions reporting for backup.
key_beats.state_change: Coordinates lock in, pointing to hidden uncharted space; the choice to report or proceed crystallizes.
key_beats.pov_reaction: Decision weight lands heavily; Ben carries the data and choice, Force-pressure like a thousand-year memory pressing the present.

key_beats.beat_description: Desh voices professional caution, reading the perimeter as Jedi military infrastructure from his GAG training.
key_beats.state_change: Interpersonal stakes rise—Desh's respected assessment frames the network as active containment, amplifying urgency.
key_beats.pov_reaction: Ben feels the pull of chain-of-command versus action; tension coils in his gut, respecting Desh's grounded read without yielding.

voice_guidance: Channel Zahn's efficient dialogue—every line advances plot or character; tight third-person interiority, sharp and self-deprecating, never melodramatic. Allston-style humor-under-stress if tension allows. Dialogue-led with Desh's practical exchanges; Force as pressure sensation only, no pitch/harmonic metaphors. Sensory palette: flickering holos, ancient power hum, visible breath in cold, durasteel chill.
forbidden_moves: Resolve any promises or subplot threads beyond advancing H03, SP-A, SP3
Introduce characters beyond Ben and Desh
anti_patterns: Ben should read the network without constructing a theory about its builders in this scene
Diagnostic-voice trap—do not arrive at clinical analysis of the network or Force
Avoid exposition dump about ancient Jedi military infrastructure—emerge through data and Desh's reading
Do not use pitch, harmonic, or navigation metaphors for Force-perception—keep pressure-register consistent with Ch3 sc1
Interpretation of coordinates waits for later—no theory-building here
